name: Medium - Vague inquiry: customer unsure of product
customer_profile: Customer in Johannesburg who needs boards but doesn't know exactly what type

messages.text: Hi there, I need boards but I'm not sure which type. What do you recommend?
I'm in Johannesburg. I think I need about 25 sheets.
Ok let's go with 16mm MDF board. Can I get a quote?

expected_behaviors.description: AI should greet and acknowledge the customer
AI should generate a quote or provide pricing
AI should attempt to close the sale

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
Internal tags should be stripped from customer-facing message

notes: Vague inquiry. AI should ask clarifying questions, help select product, then quote and close.
